Question 1
?

Consider the arc of the curve x=y3−9y that lies in the fourth quadrant between its y-intercepts. What integral gives the surface area generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
2π∫−30(y2−3)1+(y3−9y)2dy
b
2π∫−20(y2−3)1+9y4dy
c
2π∫−201+9(y2−3)2dy
d
2π∫−30(y3−9y)1+9(y2−3)2dy
e
2π∫−301+9y4dy
